title: Orbit Summit benefits overview
summary: Network marketing page. Lists rental car cover, phone protection and a lounge day pass for Orbit Summit cards, and says benefits vary by issuer and card.

title: Northwind Voyager Guide to Benefits
summary: The card's own guide. Annual travel credit. Phone protection included. Rental cover is primary with a higher cap and replaces the network's secondary cover. No mention of a lounge pass.

title: Northwind Voyager pricing and terms
summary: Names the issuer, network and network tier of the card and its annual fee.

title: Halcyon Kestrel Guide to Benefits
summary: The card's own guide. States that Orbit Summit phone protection is not offered on this card. Silent on rental cover and on the lounge pass.

title: Halcyon Kestrel pricing and terms
summary: Names the issuer, program manager, co-brand partner, network and network tier of the card and its annual fee.
